links.comparator_used: Unprocessed (not post-processed) risk prediction models and multicalibration post-processing, as implied by the abstract; the abstract does not name the comparators explicitly
links.outcome: Calibration fairness (multicalibration and differential calibration) across intersectional patient groups in ED admission prediction, and classification performance
links.effect: No numbers reported in the abstract; PMC post-processing controlled simultaneous measures of calibration fairness over intersectional groups
links.tradeoff: Virtually no cost in classification performance
links.quote: We observe that proportional multicalibration is a promising criteria for controlling simultaneous measures of calibration fairness of a model over intersectional groups with virtually no cost in terms of classification performance.
